$comment: MAGHAREBIT identity tokens, as implemented in apps/magharebit-web (tailwind.config.ts). Names follow the design board (board_final.png).

deepForest.role: Primary dark background, app chrome, theme/background color

pineGreen.role: Cards and panels on dark; headings on light

brandGreen.role: Legacy GreenGo green. Still in the scale; no longer the dominant brand color

moroccanGold.role: Primary accent / action on dark. NOT Tailwind amber-400 (#FBBF24)

deepOchre.role: Accent on light backgrounds (gold-400 only measures 1.7:1 on white)

surfaceLight.role: Light page/form background (used on the web portal login)

typography.latinDisplay: Plus Jakarta Sans (ExtraBold 800 display, Bold 700 headings)
typography.note: Set Arabic ~10% larger than adjacent Latin with 1.75x line height. Western digits (0-9) everywhere, including Arabic UI.

logoRules.namingWarning: Suffixes mean opposite things between families: emblem-light is for DARK backgrounds, logo-horizontal-dark is also for DARK backgrounds. Choose by the background, not the suffix.

zellige.stroke: #0F3D2A (pine) - invisible on dark backgrounds, so on dark screens use it as a mask over gold
zellige.rule: Behind content only, never over product UI or the emblem's star center
